relationships.subject: NaV1.8 A1073V
relationships.evidence_quote: Comparison of inactivation parameters indicated that 1073V channels were shifted to more depolarized potentials than 1073A-expressing neurons, imparting a proexcitatory characteristic.

relationships.subject: NaV1.8 A1073V
relationships.evidence_quote: we found that homozygosity for this NaV1.8 polymorphism (1073V) is observed more commonly in patients with hypoalgesic, or “silent” inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) [20].

key_findings: In rat DRG neurons with native NaV1.8 silenced, human 1073V NaV1.8 showed ~1.8 mV hyperpolarized activation, steeper slope, and ~8 mV depolarized steady-state inactivation versus 1073A.
Findings differ from sympathetic neuron and cell-line expression, highlighting expression-system dependence.
